title: The Wandering Market Trolley
intro: Someone keeps borrowing the market's big blue trolley overnight, and the stallholders want to know who.

clues.text: Mira was here kneading dough all night, flour up to her elbows. She never left the ovens.
Sam was here teaching children to wave politely at bus doors, busy until dawn.
Nina was here reading quietly to the story group, her voice too shy to carry far.
Whoever moved it left damp soil and a single marrow flower on the floor.
The trolley returned smelling of sweet compost and with one long vine trailing from the handle.

ending: It was Gwen! She borrowed the trolley to wheel her prize marrow to the show, and she's saying sorry with a basket of veg.

title: Bandstand Bunting Mix-Up
intro: Before the town fete, the bandstand bunting went missing from its crate. Everyone wants it back in time for the music.

clues.text: Ada was at Pine Hill School all evening, pinning paper trees for the class play.
Gwen stayed in the Plant Shed, tending her prize marrow and checking its soft green leaves.
Sam was at Transit Shed, polishing an old bus and showing children how the bell rings.
Near the bandstand path, someone carried folded colour strips while humming a slow march.
A quiet customer with a music folder and a scarf from last year's band performance left a small bag.

ending: It was Nina! She quietly borrowed the bunting to practice her singing with a proper bandstand sparkle, and she hung it neatly back before the fete.

title: Odd Things in the Returns Box
intro: The library's returns box has been filled with odd little things, and the staff want to know who has been muddling it.

clues.text: Sam helped stack books here until late, and I saw him leave with his bus cap and a thermos.
Nina's scarf was left on this shelf, and two staff members heard her rehearsing a soft song in the hall.
Ada stayed at school until ten, pinning fairy wings on play costumes, while the caretaker swept the hall.
By the pond, a slow trail of wet footprints led to a muddy box, with bits of lettuce and a little shell.
The returns box smelled of vet salve, and a tiny tortoise ID tag was tucked inside the lid.

ending: It was Vera! She stored damp moss, a lettuce leaf, and a tortoise ID tag in the returns box for her tracked tortoise, then tidied it.
